messages:
deploy-bot: deploy attempt failed for staging/prometheus-exporter v2.4.0 -> blocked by image-digest-mismatch check
kevin: seeing it too, image digest in eu registry != us registry for the same tag :thinking_face:
nora: did the chart bump change imagePullPolicy? we had an IfNotPresent override in values-staging.yaml before
sara: yes, chart v2.4.0 templates have a values key `image.pullPolicy` defaulting to Always now. I noticed it in the diff earlier but assumed it's harmless for staging
miguel: Always + IfNotPresent mix across overlays explains pod churn and recent evictions. when imagePullPolicy flips to Always, K8s pulls and can spike registry egress and also surface digest mismatches
jen: deploy-bot shows the preflight: `image-digest-check: failed (eu:sha256:aaa != us:sha256:bbb)`
kevin: immediate options: 1) pin to chart v2.3.7 which has IfNotPresent, 2) hotpatch values to explicitly set image.pullPolicy: IfNotPresent for staging overlays, 3) force promote the digest that matches us to all registries (not great during change window)
release-manager: we have a payroll release in the same change window in 25m. I'd rather not repush images across regions now
sara: agree, option 2 (hotpatch values) is lowest blast radius and fastest. we can patch the staging values ConfigMap/secret and re-run deploy bot canary only for staging
miguel: hotpatch steps: `helm upgrade --reuse-values --set image.pullPolicy=IfNotPresent --namespace staging prometheus-exporter redwood/prometheus-exporter --version 2.3.7` or if we must keep chart 2.4.0: `--set image.pullPolicy=IfNotPresent` to override the new default
kevin: note: helm will still render hooks from 2.4.0, so check for other template changes. recommend a dry-run first: `helm upgrade --dry-run --debug`
jen: also update release notes: call out regression in template default for 2.4.0 and the temporary staging override. add a line in the public release notes: "staging pinned to previous pullPolicy due to cross-region digest mismatch"
release-manager: do the hotpatch and then monitor canary. if canary unhealthy after 10m we roll back to 2.3.7 pin and open a follow-up to reconcile registry digests
nora: I'll apply the override now and run a dry-run then a canary. tagging @deploy-bot when ready
deploy-bot: acknowledged, will re-run canary on manual trigger when you post `@deploy-bot promote canary`
kevin: quick checklist for post-action: 1) update staging values in repo with a short commit and link (so we don't forget), 2) add a release note draft, 3) create a follow-up ticket to standardize `image.pullPolicy` in chart docs
sara: adding to release notes now, PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/abcd1234 -- mention why we hotpatched and plan to revert after registry sync
miguel: long term: registry-replication job needs stronger alerts for digest skew. I'll file RFC after this incident
release-manager: thanks team. nora, confirm when canary is green and I'll sign off to proceed with the other scheduled releases
